content: Flower Hospital is a public healthcare facility located in Sylvania, Ohio, and operates as part of the ProMedica Health System. It is designated as a Level III trauma center and is staffed by approximately 1,500 healthcare professionals who provide medical care to patients across its 297 available beds. The hospital was established in 1910 by Stevens Warren Flower as a tribute to his late wife, Ellen. Initially constructed near his residence in downtown Toledo, Ohio, the hospital was later relocated to its current location in Sylvania, Ohio, in 1975. Flower Hospital offers a range of amenities to support patients, visitors, and staff. These include a cafeteria for dining, a gift shop for purchasing items, internet access for connectivity, a library for reading and research, and pastoral services to address spiritual and emotional needs.
